description.value: Cedars Restaurant & Lounge is the main dining venue at Tigh-Na-Mara Seaside Spa Resort, a seaside spa resort on Vancouver Island near Parksville. The award-winning culinary team crafts local, regional, and international dishes from a stone oven with a rotating seasonal menu that blends rustic and contemporary styles. The restaurant includes a full lounge and bar, and takeout is also available for those not staying at the resort.
